scope: Bounded public helper log families; portable component and build evidence only
policy: Before new helper launch, retain the newest existing session family by mtime (deterministic name tie-break); SDK creates the next family and caps/rotates each log once. At most two owned normal session families after launch, without accumulating random filenames indefinitely.
preserved: Per-session random names and separate receipts
filesystem_boundary: Pinned SDK-owned data directory opened O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW; no recursion; fstatat without following links; unlinkat only strict regular single-link owned log names. Cleanup errors defer public helper launch.
targeted_controls: Forty session cycles, paired rotations, strict names, links/directories/unrelated files, directory symlink refusal and injected cleanup EIO; all three sanitizer modes pass
hook_registration: Pass under WSL host compiler; initial native-Windows invocation lacked cc and was rerun in the supported compiler environment
